remainingFixtures.note: Full fixture for all 8 teams in Open Singles/Doubles A Reserve 2, from trols.org.au.

finals.note: Top 4 make finals; 1st and 2nd host the semi final.

Burden Park::Ciara Norng.generalPlay: 20 y/o Asian girl, small build. Plays both singles and doubles. DT won 6-0, 6-1 vs her in singles.
Burden Park::Ciara Norng.strengths: Great backhand — much stronger on that side, go to backhand
Burden Park::Ciara Norng.weaknesses: Forehand is a weakness — not much power. Average serves.

Burden Park::Alan.serving: Decent serve — likes to go out wide
Burden Park::Alan.generalPlay: Late 40s Asian guy. Only played doubles. Okay at rallies. Possibly listed as Lun Wang in results.
Burden Park::Alan.strengths: Decent serve, comfortable at baseline rallies
Burden Park::Alan.weaknesses: Very bad at the net — missed 4-5 easy volleys from about 1 metre away. Target him at net.

Burden Park::Isaac Khaoula.generalPlay: Mid-20s guy — definition of a pusher. Slices 90% of the time. Rallies last 10-20 shots each. Gives no pace, just slice and some topspin forehands. Looks a very frustrating player to play against.
Burden Park::Isaac Khaoula.strengths: Incredible consistency — will grind out every point
Burden Park::Isaac Khaoula.weaknesses: Doesn't like pace on the run, but hitting with pace is risky (high error rate). Try varying pace and angles to disrupt rhythm.

Monash Uni::Srinivas Tirumalasetty.serving: Average serve with short toss/swing (similar to Devraj). Serves wide to Deuce side; served down the line on Ad side.
Monash Uni::Srinivas Tirumalasetty.generalPlay: Indian guy, early 20s. Played doubles only. Probably a 2 or 3 on Tuesday. Lost to Shannon & DT in doubles 6-2, 7-5.
Monash Uni::Srinivas Tirumalasetty.weaknesses: Doesn't last long in a rally. No surprise shots down the tramline. Not good at volleying. Consistently hits DT's slice serve to backhand straight to the net player — use that serve.

Monash Uni::Kevin Chen.serving: Decent 1st serve but only hits it ~20% of the time. 2nd serve is a slow slice with a big bounce.
Monash Uni::Kevin Chen.generalPlay: Tallish Asian guy. Played doubles only. Probably a 2 on Tuesday. Lost to Shannon & DT in doubles 6-2, 7-5.
Monash Uni::Kevin Chen.strengths: Good at rallies from the baseline
Monash Uni::Kevin Chen.weaknesses: Struggles with serves to his backhand.

Monash Uni::Zachary Lee.serving: Slow tossing action (similar to Craig) — restarts toss a lot. Very quick to hit 2nd serve. 1st serve is average. 2nd serve is close to a lollipop.
Monash Uni::Zachary Lee.generalPlay: Young Asian guy, average height, skinny, early 20s. Played singles only. ~2 on Tuesday. Lost to DT in singles 7-5, 6-3.
Monash Uni::Zachary Lee.strengths: Very quick around the court. Good passing shots when opponent comes to net. Great dropshots — hit ~4-5 winners in the match.
Monash Uni::Zachary Lee.weaknesses: Backhand is very slow and bounces short — rush the net for a volley after a decent shot to his backhand corner. Tell him to slow down his 2nd serve next time.

Monash Uni::Matthew Lee.generalPlay: Young Asian guy. Played singles only. ~1/2 on Tuesday. Lost to Nick in singles 6-3, 6-4. Plays long rallies with moonball/deep topspin shots.
Monash Uni::Matthew Lee.strengths: Deep topspin baseline game — moonballs and high heavy balls
